entities.summary: John Thomas "Mac" McAleese, MM was a Scottish soldier who took part in several late 20th century conflicts with the British Army's Royal Engineers and the Special Air Service. During his time in the Special Air Service, he notably had a role in the storming of the Iranian Embassy in London during a hostage-taking siege in May 1980.
